data.gender_notes: Donato is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word ‘donare’, meaning ‘to give’, ‘Donato’ means ‘given by God’. It is the name of several early Christian saints, including Donatus of Tagaste, a prominent theologian in the late 4th century, and Donatus of Arezzo, who was a bishop in the 10th century. The name Donato carries the meaning “Given by God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Donato usually hope their child will grow to embody given by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Δονάτο
in_greek.long_meaning: Δονάτο προέρχεται από το λατινικό όνομα Donatus, που σημαίνει 'δοσμένος' ή 'δώρο'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, η έννοια του ονόματος συνδέεται με την πνευματική δωρεά και την αγάπη του Θεού. Ο Δονάτο συμβολίζει την αθανασία και τη γενναιοδωρία του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Donato
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Donato originem habet in Latino, derivatum a verbo 'donare', quod significat 'dare' vel 'donatio'. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Donatus erat symbolum gratiae et amoris divini. Donato igitur personam significat quae dono Dei est ornată.
